messages:
tara: hitting intermittent SSE JSON.parse errors in the node sampleapp after a reconnect. saw leading newlines get merged into data and break parse.

ben: ouch. can you paste the raw chunks? which retry strategy (linear/backoff)?

tara: using exponential backoff in examples. capture (trimmed): ```
id: 7
data: {"text":"hello"}

``` then after reconnect first chunk looked like: ```


data: {"text":"\nworld"}
``` which produced `Unexpected token \n` on JSON.parse.

mohammed: hmmm. our naive `split('\n\n')` will produce an empty part for those leading blank lines. Quick mitigation: ignore events where `data.trim() === ''` before attempting JSON.parse. Still want robust line-state parser long term.

ben: agreed. proper fix: incremental line parser that accumulates partial lines (preserve partial `data:`), treats `\r?\n` consistently, and only emits on a full blank line. also preserve `id` so resume headers can be set.

tara: i can add a tiny patch with the `data.trim()` guard + `--sse-debug` flag to dump raw frames, and a netem-based test that drops packets mid-data to repro reliably. will follow up with parser refactor in a separate PR.

sdk-bot: build queued for branch tara/sse-empty-data-guard (CI: sampleapp-unit).

ci-bot: created ticket #4250: "sse: ignore-empty-data-events + parser improvement" and added to streaming-parity epic.

ben: please add a cross-SDK regression test (node + browser + python) to streaming-parity that injects blank-line sequences crossing reconnects. that will catch this class of bugs.

tara: PR opened: minimal guard + test + debug flag. pinging for review. :rocket:
